Ava Chen: hey team — short notice. my flight just got delayed and i've got tonight's primary (22:00-04:00 UTC). there's an open P1 (INC-3472) that's stable but not fully resolved. can someone pick up primary for that window? i can hand off context now. :airplane:

oncall-bot: [INC-3472] ALERT -> High error rate on model-serving-prod. Current state: degraded (since 1793329000). Link: https://redwood-incidents/INC-3472 

Marcus Díaz: i can take primary for 22:00-04:00 UTC if nobody else steps up. want a warm 10m overlap? what do you want me to check first?

Ava Chen: thanks, marcus — very appreciated. quick context:
- spike started after deploy at ~21:10 UTC, error-rate ~3.2% -> now ~0.6%
- fallback is in place (model-variant B) but some requests still hit legacy path
- customer impact: higher lat for embeddings and some 5xxs to batch inference

runbook bits: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/serving-deg
hand-off checklist (quick):
```
1) confirm rotation-cli whoami
2) check incctl status INC-3472
3) tail -n 200 /var/log/serving/model-service.log | grep ERROR
4) ensure fallback variant is healthy
```

Priya Nair: i'll shadow until the handoff completes, happy to own the first 10m overlap. ava — can you paste the last kube rollout id? i'll grab logs. :spiral_note_pad:

Ava Chen: kube-rollout id: rollout-2026-1793328600. logs show repeated OOM at worker-3 before we scaled it up. also pinned a quick grep filter: `grep -i "oom" /var/log/serving/model-service.log | tail -20`

Marcus Díaz: claiming primary now. running: `rotation-cli claim --role primary --window 22:00-04:00UTC --note "late flight swap / handoff INC-3472"` — will update the calendar. i'll start with health checks + obs dashboards, then run the fallback verification. @Priya i'll PM for overlap timing. :thumbsup:

Ava Chen: perfect — please also watch CPU and queue-lengths on embeddings-queue (SLO breach if qlen > 300). if you see CPU >80% on worker-3 escalate to infra with runbook link above.

Jamie Cole: i'll be secondary for the window and keep an eye on rerankers/embeds. if anything spikes on the rerank path i'll take immediate action to shift traffic to variant-B. runbook to spam-link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue 

oncall-bot: rotation updated -> primary: Marcus Díaz (22:00-04:00 UTC), secondary: Jamie Cole. calendar event updated: https://calendar.redwood.com/rotation/2026-03-15/22:00 

Priya Nair: adding a handoff note to INC-3472: "Ava started handoff due to travel delay; Marcus assumed primary at 22:00 UTC; Jamie secondary; Priya shadowed 10m overlap." I'll do a quick post-handoff smoke test at +5m.

Marcus Díaz: got it. smoke test passed at +6m (latencies back to baseline, 5xxs at ~0.2%). i'll post a short summary in the incident once i finish the runbook verification. thanks all for the quick assist. :white_check_mark:
